source.quote: the Murdoch Family Trust (“MFT”), which beneficially owns less than one percent of the Company’s outstanding Class A Common Stock and approximately 40.6% of the Company’s Class B Common Stock as of June 30, 2025 ... Thus, K. Rupert Murdoch may be deemed to beneficially own in the aggregate less than one percent of the Company’s Class A Common Stock and approximately 41.2% of the Company’s Class B Common Stock as of June 30, 2025.

structure.note: Class A shares are non-voting except in limited circumstances; Class B shares carry one vote each. At June 30, 2025 the Murdoch Family Trust owned about 40.6% of Class B. Rupert Murdoch, who can appoint certain directors of the trust's corporate trustee, may be deemed to beneficially own about 41.2% of Class B including his own shares, and disclaims beneficial ownership of the trust's shares (FY2025 10-K). A stockholders agreement caps the trust and Murdoch family at 44% of Class B voting power. The October 2025 proxy says that in September 2025 'certain trusts established for the benefit of certain beneficiaries of the Murdoch Family Trust' sold 14,071,293 Class B shares, and its ownership table (September 10, 2025) no longer lists the trust or Rupert Murdoch; it lists LGC Holdco, LLC with 62,584,577 Class B shares (33.3% of the class), whose voting decisions are made by a managing director appointed by Lachlan Murdoch.

notes: Fiscal year ended June 30, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Jun 2025'). Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001564708-25-000419) and the proxy published after it, the 2025 DEF 14A (accession 0001140361-25-037696, ownership as of September 10, 2025). OWNERSHIP AS-OF DATE, a judgment call: ownership is taken from the 10-K as of June 30, 2025, the fiscal-year end, because the October 2025 proxy's table (September 10, 2025) comes after the September 2025 sale described below and does not list Rupert Murdoch or the Murdoch Family Trust. He has been Chairman Emeritus, not a director, since November 15, 2023, he is not among the fiscal 2025 named executive officers, and he is not listed as a more-than-5% Class B holder. pctVoting is 41.2, the 10-K's percentage of Class B, the only class that generally votes (10-K Note 12: Class A votes only in limited circumstances; Class B carries one vote per share). It is approximate ('approximately 41.2%') and he disclaims beneficial ownership of the trust's shares. pctEconomic is null: the 10-K gives only class percentages and no share counts, so no economic share can be derived. On those figures it would be well under his voting share, since Class B is about a third of all shares. The trust is not listed separately (family is null) because its 40.6% is already inside Rupert's 41.2%. The September 2025 events are described in structure.note from the proxy: a sale of 14,071,293 Class B shares, and LGC Holdco, LLC with 62,584,577 Class B shares (33.3%), which Lachlan Murdoch may be deemed to beneficially own (he disclaims it). LARGEST HOLDERS is null: the proxy lists only more-than-5% holders of Class B, as % of Class B (LGC Holdco 33.3%; SOF Ltd 9,781,882 shares, 5.2%, as of December 31, 2022), not on an all-shares basis. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' ($185m) includes dividends to REA Group minority holders (MD&A: 'dividend payments of $185 million to News Corporation stockholders and REA Group minority stockholders'). The equity statement splits it into $114m to News Corporation stockholders and $71m to noncontrolling interests, so $114m is recorded. No XBRL fact for the $114m was found in companyfacts. BUYBACKS: $150m repurchased Class A and Class B shares. GEOGRAPHY: U.S. alone about $4.0bn, U.K. about $1.2bn, Australia about $2.2bn (10-K footnotes). Australasia comprises Australia, Asia, Papua New Guinea and New Zealand. Revenue figures are as reported for continuing operations. No broad employee stock purchase plan was identified, so plan is null.
